cues.text:
The hands that shaped the heavens
And scattered every star

Reached into this broken world
And met us where we are

They touched the ones forgotten
The ones no one would see

The hands that made creation
Reached down and made them clean

Power enough to form the world
Tender enough to touch

The hands that held the nails
Are the hands that hold me now

The hands that bore the scars
Will never let me down

The hands that healed the broken
Still reach for me somehow

The hands that held the nails
Are the hands that hold me now
They took a child by the hand

And called her back to life
They broke the bread for thousands

They served throughout the night
They washed the feet of sinners

Though heaven shouts His name
The hands that ruled creation

Chose a towel over fame
Strong enough to conquer death

Humble enough to serve
The hands that held the nails

Are the hands that hold me now
The hands that bore the scars

Will never let me down
The hands that healed the broken

Still reach for me somehow
The hands that held the nails
Are the hands that hold me now

The hands that blessed the broken
Were wounded for my sin

The hands that gave out mercy
Were opened once again

And when the grave stood empty
The scars still told the story

The hands that death could not hold down
Were lifted up in glory

The wounds were still upon His hands
But death had lost its claim

The hands that held the nails
Are the hands that hold me now

The hands that bore the scars
Will never let me down

The hands that healed the broken
Still reach for me somehow

The hands that held the nails
Are the hands that hold me now

The hands that held the nails
Are the hands that hold me now

When I am afraid
You hold me

When I lose my way
You guide me

When I cannot stand
You carry me

No one can take me
From Your hand

You hold me
(You hold me)

You keep me
(You keep me)

Scarred hands
Still reaching

Grace and mercy
still revealing

The hands that held the nails
Are the hands that hold me now

The hands that bore the scars
Will never let me down

The hands that healed the broken
Still reach for me somehow

The hands that held the nails
Are the hands that hold me now

The hands that held the nails
Are the hands that hold me now

The hands that shaped the heavens
The hands that raised the dead

They washed the feet of men;
Were wounded in my stead

And nothing in creation
Can take me from them now

The hands that held the nails
Are the hands that hold me now

The hands that held the nails
Still hold me now
